title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the heat of vaporization must be correctly calculated as 4.8 x 10^10 ergs/mol.

title: Conversion Factor
description: Important Criteria: The conversion from eV to ergs must be correctly applied using the factor 1 eV = 1.6 x 10^-12 erg.

title: Avogadro's Number
description: Important Criteria: The use of Avogadro's number (6.023 x 10^23) in the calculation must be correctly included.

title: Initial Energy Value
description: Important Criteria: The initial energy value of 1/20 eV must be correctly identified and used in the calculation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units must be consistent throughout the calculation, confirming that the final answer is in ergs/mol.

title: Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any arithmetic errors in the multiplication or conversion steps will lead to a significant deduction.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrect signs in the final answer or intermediate steps will result in a deduction.
